subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Spend Analysis
description: A micro-lesson that makes Spend Analysis usable.

hook.text: A company discovers it spent $4 million on identical parts from three suppliers at three different prices.

buildup.text: Spend analysis collects, cleans, and categorizes all purchasing data to reveal where the money goes.

discovery.text: It identifies duplicate suppliers, rogue spending, contract leakage, and consolidation opportunities.

twist.text: Most companies can't easily see their own spend. Data is scattered across ERPs, spreadsheets, and card statements.

climax.text: A thorough spend analysis typically uncovers 5–15% savings opportunities that were previously invisible.

punchline.text: You can't save what you can't see. Analyze the spend first.

quiz.question: What does spend analysis typically uncover?
